title: Indian Air Force Agniveer Vayu Full Length Mock Test 10 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for IAF Agniveer Vayu (Science + Other than Science combined pattern). 100 Questions | 85 Minutes | English 20, Physics 25, Mathematics 25, Reasoning & General Awareness 30.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 100 questions: English 20, Physics 25, Mathematics 25, Reasoning & General Awareness 30.
Har question 1 mark ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.25 marks katenge.
Time: 85 minutes (official combined Science + Other than Science pattern).
Physics and Mathematics 10+2 CBSE level; English 10+2; RAGA includes Reasoning and GK/Defence.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
options: The pilot announced, 'We will divert to the alternate airfield.'
The pilot announced 'We will divert to the alternate airfield.'
The pilot announced, We will divert to the alternate airfield.
The pilot announced; 'We will divert to the alternate airfield.'
questions.explanation: A comma precedes a direct quotation and quotation marks enclose the spoken words.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Change into passive: The ground crew calibrated the ILS receivers.
options: The ILS receivers were calibrated by the ground crew.
The ILS receivers are calibrated by the ground crew.
The ILS receivers have calibrated the ground crew.
The ILS receivers had been calibrating by the ground crew.
questions.explanation: Simple past active → was/were + past participle.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The CO said to the flight, 'Do not taxi until clearance is received.'
options: The CO ordered the flight not to taxi until clearance was received.
The CO told the flight do not taxi until clearance is received.
The CO said the flight that not to taxi until clearance is received.
The CO asked the flight to not taxi until clearance is received.
questions.explanation: Imperative with past reporting verb → ordered + not to + sequence of tenses.
